_meta.description: Sample data for bd_franklin_rodriguez_thompson. Designed to demonstrate the non-negotiable requirement (per-channel isolation) live, without having to create data by hand.
_meta.demo_password_note: Every user in this seed shares this DEMO password. The password_hash values below are real bcrypt hashes (cost 12) of that value -- the plaintext password is never stored, not even in test data.
_meta.loading_order: users -> channels -> channel_members -> messages -> message_reads -> copilot_usage_logs (respects the FKs).
_meta.reference_convention: channel_members/messages/message_reads/copilot_usage_logs reference users by their explicit `key` below (e.g. "user_ana"), and channels by their `name` (e.g. "general") -- both resolved by backend/scripts/seed.ts before inserting.

_business_rules_implicit: user_bruno and user_carla were NEVER added to 'backend': they must get 0 results if they search for or ask about its content, even via the copilot.
user_diego and user_elena were NEVER added to 'design': same case, the other way around.
user_elena is a member of 'backend' but never used the copilot (no rows in copilot_usage_logs): used to test the empty state of 'cumulative usage per user'.
The 'backend' messages about the search-index incident (msg5-msg7) are exactly the content bruno asks about in the second copilot_usage_logs case, which the copilot must refuse to answer.
